hint.zh: 先假设「下雨」，要证的就是「地湿」，一句没有 ¬ 的话。
hint.en: Assume “it rains” first; what remains is “the ground is wet”, with no ¬ in it.
“The ground is wet” comes the way it did in <level-ref to="byContra"></level-ref>.

t.zh: <level-ref to="mt"></level-ref>从原句推出了它的<wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref>。这一回反过来，从逆否推回原句。
t.en: <level-ref to="mt"></level-ref> derived a sentence’s <wiki-ref to="contrapositive"></wiki-ref> from it. This time the other way: from the contrapositive back to the sentence.
